title: Container Census
story: The welcome API vanished from the dashboard, but its container still exists. Metrics is healthy, and replacing things before checking their state is how last Friday became a retrospective.
objective: Ensure both existing api and metrics containers are running, with exactly two mission containers remaining.
hints: Images are reusable templates; containers are instances with their own running or stopped lifecycle state.
Use docker ps -a to include stopped containers and inspect api before changing anything.
Start the existing container with docker start api. Do not create a replacement with docker run.
explanation: An image is the reusable template, while a container is a particular instance with its own lifecycle. A stopped container can be started again without creating a replacement, preserving its identity and configuration.
